scenario: agent unpaired, IPC socket listening, no client, idle
machine: Mac14,15 (MacBook Air 15-inch, Apple M2), macOS 26.5.1 (25F80), AC power, Low Power Mode off, no thermal warning
build: cargo build --release -p fogar-agentd; codesign -s 'Apple Development' -i com.fogar.agent --options runtime
method: perf/measure.sh: 120 s warm-up, 624 s window; CPU/wakeups/footprint exact from proc_pid_rusage deltas (perf/rusage.py), POWER/IDLEW from top every 30 s; 3 instances in parallel with separate --state-dir, median reported
notes: Machine was NOT quiet: load average 45 -> 28 during the window (other agent sessions building/fuzzing, CPU ~0.4% idle). The package was rarely idle, so ri_pkg_idle_wkups and top IDLEW read 0 and are deliberately left out of this baseline (idle-gate.sh skips missing keys); ri_interrupt_wkups_per_s is the wakeup figure to compare. Re-measure on a quiet machine before tightening.

0.40 wakeups/s is most likely (source reading, not traced) two unaligned 10 s timers (Config::heartbeat_every in the runtime thread and the watchdog thread's park_timeout(10 s)) plus tokio wheel cascade; skill rule 2 says align them.
QoS: rusage reports CPU time only under UTILITY (default and background 0) in the window.
No power assertions held by fogar-agentd (pmset -g assertions).
No thread budget is declared for S1 yet; 4 threads observed.
NOT RUN: powermetrics (needs sudo), memory_pressure -S warn, burst-then-idle, 24 h soak.
